description: Find over 100 ways to quench your thirst. The Coca-Cola Freestyle app helps you find the nearest spot where you can explore endless possibilities. With our location finder, you can discover nearby locations that have a Coca-Cola Freestyle fountain with 100+ choices waiting for you. It also shows you where to get good deals from your favorite restaurants, movie theaters and more. Once you find a place to enjoy, you can earn badges and prizes by checking in and exploring all of the brands available. You can also use the app to explore and save your favorite brands.
